targets.descriptor: A cropped collarless jacket with a round neck finished in a self-fabric braided/cord trim that also runs the full front edge, the sleeve ends and the lower hem. A single centre column of round gold-tone buttons runs from neck to hem. Over the pale textured ground, naturalistic multicolour botanical sprays are worked across the two front panels and up both sleeves — each spray a tall stem with mixed blossoms (pink, yellow, coral, lilac) and olive foliage — reading as hand-embroidered placed motifs rather than a regular repeat. A matching braided-cord trim band also appears below the hem, part of the coordinating skirt beneath.
